business_overview.one_sentence: Sundart is an integrated fitting-out contractor operating in Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore and Mainland China, with ancillary manufacturing, sourcing and distribution of interior decorative materials.

segments.name: Manufacturing, sourcing and distribution of interior decorative materials

business_overview.revenue_model: Project contracting revenue is recognised over time by input method; customers are generally billed monthly by work progress, with some customers providing 5%-30% advance deposits and retention commonly around 5% of contract sum.
business_notes: The group completed 106 fitting-out projects in 2025 and had 167 projects on hand at year end.
The largest disclosed risk is project non-recurring nature, tender success, reliance on major customers, and Macau/Hong Kong/Mainland project demand.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year median operating cash flow is above median parent profit, but 2025 operating cash flow fell sharply because receivables and contract assets absorbed cash. Capital expenditure in 2025 was unusually high, so maintenance capex is estimated near the 2024/2023 normal capex range rather than the 2025 expansion/acquisition year.

gaps: The 2025 annual report does not split bank balances and fixed deposits by holding entity, geography, parent/subsidiary, or onshore/offshore availability.
No precise management disclosure was found for minimum cash required to operate the construction project pipeline.
The 2024 English annual report PDF on the company media host returned HTTP 403 to direct download; 2024 figures were taken from the 2025 annual report comparative columns.
